# Define the theme's PRD, TRD and TDD

Establish the new theme's direction before changing the starter. Create a Product Requirements Document (PRD), Technical Requirements Document (TRD) and Technical Design Document (TDD) for this theme. Keep the documents focused on theme behaviour; refer to the [ScissorHands.NET theme documentation](https://getscissorhands.app/docs/themes/) for engine contracts instead of copying it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The PRD identifies the intended audience, purpose, content types, key page journeys and visual/interaction goals.
- [ ] The TRD describes the seven required Razor views, static HTML output, framework-free CSS/JavaScript, theme and site configuration, accessibility, localization and URL requirements.
- [ ] The TDD explains the chosen layout, components, styles, asset strategy and interaction design, including the optional manual hero carousel and its no-JavaScript presentation.
- [ ] The documents distinguish confirmed decisions from open questions and give the implementation issues a usable reference.
